pages.title: Degenerate Armour Plate
pages.text: A slab of neutronium that should, by rights, explode back into a cloud of free neutrons the moment it leaves a star. The spacetime-alloy frame keeps the pressure on, so the plate stays degenerate: neutrons packed shoulder to shoulder, refusing by the Pauli principle to be squeezed any further.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Neutronium decompresses violently outside a star, so I tried caging a block in spacetime alloy and letting the Casimir Vacuum Press hold the vacuum around it. The neutrons stayed locked. Anything that can survive a compact star's interior can survive me.
